reason: A UI presentation plugin that renders recorded tool calls as compact expandable rows with parameter, result, error, status, and trace details.

summaries.zh: 将已记录的工具调用以紧凑可折叠行展示，并支持查看参数、结果、错误、状态和对应轨迹。
summaries.en: Presents recorded tool calls as compact expandable rows with their parameters, results, errors, statuses, and corresponding traces.

capabilities: Displays recorded tool calls, results, errors, and trace information in compact expandable rows
Provides collapsible and replay-consistent presentation of tool-call state
Supports navigation from an expanded call to its corresponding trace inspection
